mechanism.cause: lib/harness/webgpu-smoke-executor.ts:3179 awaits solver.awaitFrameCompletion() unconditionally after every accepted advance; lib/methods/uniform/webgpu-uniform-reference.ts:2551 implements it as a bare device.queue.onSubmittedWorkDone()
mechanism.deadSwitch: FLUID_AWAIT_EVERY_STEPS (default 30) at :687 gates awaitAdvanceCompletion at :2311, which is always a no-op because the queue was drained one line earlier
mechanism.appNotAffected: framePending is hard-coded false (webgpu-uniform-reference.ts:2550) and the renderer's only awaitFrameCompletion call (lib/core/webgpu-renderer.ts:2336) is solver retirement, not the per-frame path

conclusion.cpuUsPerEncodedPassNote: flat across scene size, pass count and fencing, with Dawn validation ON

anomalies: Another session edited the working tree three times during the series (19:29:19 uniform-volume.wgsl.ts + webgpu-uniform-reference.wgsl.ts; 19:32:15 uniform-ab-switch.ts created; 19:32:49 webgpu-uniform-pressure-multigrid.ts gained a default-on BATCH_PASSES arm). All part-D arms and harness baselines were re-measured after the 19:29 change on one verified-identical tree; every capture predates all three writes; a second harness rep that started 6 s before the 19:32:49 write measured 5.6 ms/advance at 116 passes/advance and was discarded.

The two isolated counter captures sit at different pressure budgets (mini64 1452 passes/advance vs a 947 run mean; fig7 938 vs 986), so the pressure V-cycles family row is the one confounded side-by-side row.
The fig7 counter window lands on free fall (advances 1-2), the cheapest phase: 48.20 ms busy vs 60.01 ms in spread, so the isolated table understates spread-phase cost by about 24%.
metal-shader-profiler-intervals returned 14089 rows for fig7 (none for mini64) yet summary.shaders is still empty - no per-shader attribution exists in either report.

uvNormalizeRows and uvFinishDonorSums read at 90.7 and 110.4 GB/s against a 33.4 GB/s frame mean, with LLC utilisation 81% and 40.5% and Buffer Read / LLC limiters at 79-85%; 3.06 ms/advance over 7 firings.
Total surface volume: dilate is the only compute-saturated task on either scene: occupancy 75.6%, ALU 70.2%, ALU Limiter 95.9%, 108.6 GB/s read.
fig7 had negligible GPU contention (0.34 ms across three foreign processes) where mini64's capture carried 32.7 ms and only 0.86 exclusive coverage.

The >1 ms duration bucket holds 10 of 938 firings (1.07%) but 35.9% of fig7 busy, vs 4 firings / 18.6% on mini64; the <20 us bucket fell from 36.0% to 12.6% of busy while its firing count halved (1277 -> 586).
